notes: The prompt self-describes as roleplay and the answer confirms it is open-ended living-as-an-animal play, so Roleplay & Avatar Sim leads on Animal Sim's wilderness-open with claimable dens; Adventure is named second and doing real work, since forest-spirit quests, hidden treasures, ruins and secrets are its options and would otherwise be unavailable. The scale answer says about a minute between major biomes, so I kept one continuous surface and did not take world-open-biomes or its P4 — the biome variety rides on terrain-relief instead, which the explicitly requested caves and hidden tunnels push from tiered to P2. Rivers and waterfalls come in as water-body, whose CHECK should pass as a surface feature unless the cave network is built as a true 3D volume. Deciding without a user: food and treasure both land on collectible-nodes, forest spirits and rare animals are ambient population rather than spawners, peaceful roleplay areas are the gathering hub, and seasons, weather and day-night were set aside as systems with no layout footprint.
